knownGaps: Tixr event pages (the only per-event pages the site links to) are DataDome-blocked (403 for curl, headless Chrome, and the /api path), so descriptions, door times and ticket tiers beyond the JSON-LD single price are not captured; endTime is asserted only where a flyer states it (7 of 16).
JSON-LD startDate/endDate are date-only ("Sep 10, 2026"); times come from the visible "H:MM PM" line. endDate is copied from JSON-LD as published (next-day for late shows, same-day for early ones).

traps.label: Homepage: 17 "GET TICKETS" link rows followed by a 6-card grid of the same events, then "view EVENTS CALENDAR"
traps.why: The homepage renders every calendar event twice (a plain link list of all 17, then a card grid of the first 6 with JSON-LD), and /calendar renders the same 17 a third time. Same title + date + tixr URL each time; the scraper must fold them (run 20260909-072307: 23 raw events, 8 duplicates removed).

traps.label: "FEATURED EVENTS" heading with "No items found." on /calendar
traps.why: An empty Webflow CMS list — the featured collection has no items. A heading with no events beneath it; nothing to extract.

traps.label: January … December buttons and "Show All Events" on /calendar
traps.why: Finsweet cmsfilter month buttons (client-side filtering of the already-rendered list). Month names next to the cards are UI chrome, not event dates.

traps.label: Hours: Tuesday Closed / Wednesday 7PM–2 AM / … / Monday Closed (site footer, every page)
traps.why: Opening hours, rendered as weekday + time pairs on every page — looks like a weekly schedule but is the venue's hours block, not events.

traps.label: BLOWPOP — "Thursdays" — "Every Thursday at Massive is our wildly popular and free party BlowPOP!" (/monthly-events)
traps.why: Undated programming blurb on /monthly-events. The dated calendar (Aug 2026 – Jan 2027) lists no BlowPOP instance; Thursdays on the calendar are PACK (Sep 10) and TKVR (3rd Thursdays). Run 20260909-072307 manufactured a "BLOWPOP" event dated 2026-09-10 from this paragraph. Run 20261017-054812 still extracted it from /monthly-events with a date derived from the blurb's weekday (📅 DATE ORPHAN: the date appears nowhere in the page's own text — report-only) and the owner stamped it not_bear in the deck; the daily audit called it fake. Per the fragment ruling (no time, no link, no date) it should not be proposed.

The card's printed clock is the listing's start; a doors time is not a conflict to resolve in the flyer's favour. The audit's "time wrong (page 8:30 PM, record 7:30 PM)" is right.
